print(apis.api_docs.show_api_doc(app_name='spotify', api_name='show_song_queue'))

spotify_username='cheweber@gmail.com'
spotify_password='YJh}7_a'
res=apis.spotify.login(username=spotify_username,password=spotify_password)
print(res)
spotify_token=res.get('access_token')
print('token_present', bool(spotify_token))

# Fetch current queue
assert 'spotify_token' in globals() and spotify_token
queue=apis.spotify.show_song_queue(access_token=spotify_token)
print(queue)
print('queue_len', len(queue) if isinstance(queue,list) else None)

# Fetch all liked songs (paginated)
page_index=0
page_limit=20
liked_song_ids=[]
while True:
    res=apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=spotify_token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page',page_index,'res_len',len(res) if isinstance(res,list) else None)
    if not res:
        break
    liked_song_ids.extend([s['song_id'] for s in res])
    # If API returns fewer than page_limit, still could be more; we'll rely on empty page check
    page_index+=1
    if page_index>50:
        break
liked_song_ids=set(liked_song_ids)
print('total_liked_song_ids',len(liked_song_ids))

# Determine which queued songs are in liked songs
queue_items=queue
remove_candidates=[]
for item in queue_items:
    if item['song_id'] in liked_song_ids:
        remove_candidates.append({'position': item['position'], 'song_id': item['song_id'], 'title': item['title']})
print('liked_song_ids_count', len(liked_song_ids))
print('queue_len', len(queue_items))
print('matched_liked_in_queue_count', len(remove_candidates))
# sort by position descending for safe deletion
remove_positions=sorted([c['position'] for c in remove_candidates], reverse=True)
print('remove_positions', remove_positions)
print('matched_details', remove_candidates)

current=[item for item in post_queue if item.get('is_current')]
print('current_items',[(x['position'],x['song_id'],x['title'],x.get('is_playing')) for x in current])
# also print first few positions
print('queue_positions',[item['position'] for item in post_queue])
